description: Shop a photo: an outfit picture, a street-style shot, a screenshot or a room. Look at the image yourself and send the pieces you see as `pieces` (description such as 'oversized camel wool coat', plus subcategory, colors, materials, style_tags and gender when clear). Vitrine returns the closest pieces it indexes for each one, matched on type, color, material and style, with price, stock and a link. Send image_url or image_base64 only if you cannot see the image; that path may be unavailable. Never describe people, only what they wear or what is in the room. Filters apply to every match (max_price per piece, size, ship_to). Returns {source, count, pieces: [{seen, matches}]}; then call complete_the_look on a match to finish the outfit. Read-only. Without a key, results are capped at 5 and omit trend data and match reasons; a free key (POST https://vitrine.fashion/v1/keys, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>') unlocks them. Rate limits: 10 calls a minute anonymous, 60 with a key.

anyOf.description: Optional self-identification. Identified callers help us rank better; keys make it reliable.

session_id.description: Your own opaque id linking calls in one shopping session. Never a user id.

filters.description: Hard filters. Applied before ranking; an item that fails any of them is never returned.

colors.description: Item must come in at least one of these colors.

gender.description: Department: women, men or unisex. 'men' returns men's and unisex pieces, 'women' returns women's and unisex pieces, 'unisex' returns unisex pieces only. Set gender_exact to true to drop the unisex pieces.

gender_exact.description: With gender, true matches that department only, without unisex pieces.

size.description: Item must be available in this size, e.g. 'M' or '32'.

subcategory.description: Product type, e.g. 'coat', 'sneakers', 'vase'. Exact values: vocabulary.

image_base64.description: A base64 JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP (up to about 5 MB), instead of image_url.

image_url.description: An https image URL, when you cannot describe the photo yourself. Needs Vitrine vision.

per_piece.description: Matches per piece, 1 to 5. Anonymous callers get 1.

items.description: One piece seen in a photo, described by the calling agent (or by Vitrine's own vision).

description.description: What the piece is, in a few words: 'oversized camel wool coat', 'white leather low sneakers'.

gender.description: Department the piece is cut for, if clear.

subcategory.description: Product type, from the vocabulary tool.

pieces.description: The pieces you see in the photo (preferred: use your own vision). Up to 8.

name: shop_the_look

gender.description: Department. Accessories and interior are usually unisex.

outbound_url.description: Tracked link to the retailer's product page. Checkout happens there.

why.description: One-line reason it matches. With a key.
